title: Employ staff under the Fitness Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Fitness Industry Award 2020.

sources.title: Fitness Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia engaged in the fitness industry and their employees in the classifications in this award to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Fitness Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 The fitness industry means the operation or provision of: (a) fitness centres; (b) fitness services or classes; (c) group fitness organisations; (d) weight loss/control centres; (e) aquatic centres; (f) aquatic services or classes; (g) indoor sports centres; (h) golf driving ranges; (i) dance centres; (j) martial arts centres; (k) recreational camps; (l) tennis clubs and centres; (m) tennis coaching or classes; and (n) gymnastic services, activities or classes.

sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Fitness Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
